title: GRPO · fresh standard rank-1 LoRA control (100 steps from base)
analysis: Fresh 100-update standard LoRA control for the completed gradual-refresh trial. Same refresh worker, model, dataset, initial adapter, AdamW, constant LR 1.5e-5, alpha 32, eight rollouts, 32 prompts/update, 8192 response budget, eight GPUs, checkpoint/evaluation cadence and telemetry. Only method flags differ: refresh disabled and angle zero. No resumed checkpoint and no merge or optimizer-state reset. AIME25 sampled avg@8/pass@8 every twenty updates. Hourly monitoring and ten-second NVML sampling, plus actual training allocator peaks on each rank. This tests the original budget and runtime rather than extending the candidate. Performance parity remains unproven until complete held-out results and replication; no outcome is assumed at launch.

initial-adapter-audit.json.optimizer_reset: none; preserve A moments and all counters, project B first moment by cosine, retain B variance
initial-adapter-audit.json.rollout_sync: base W then adapter after merge/resume; adapter only otherwise
initial-adapter-audit.json.probe: one real math response prefix per rank, at most 128 response tokens
initial-adapter-audit.json.rank_diagnostic: thin QR / small SVD of accumulated low-rank factors
initial-adapter-audit.json.compensation: W += scale * B @ (A_old - A_new); B unchanged
initial-adapter-audit.json.moment_transport: approximate for B; unknown orthogonal-direction variance is not reconstructed
